name: @altruist/client
description: Altruist game-client SDK above the wire: an HTTP API client with in-memory bearer tokens, single-flight refresh over the refresh cookie and CSRF header, and typed ApiError (twin of Altruist HttpErrors / RefreshCookie); a matchmaking / lobby / rejoin phase machine over AltruistSocket with Altruist's QueueState, LobbyRejectReason and RoomNoticeKind; a status poller; and device pairing (a phone as a controller of the game on a TV) over WebRTC with a server-relay path. Builds on @altruist/net; no other dependencies.
